At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Finance and Accounting professional responsible for leading end-to-end Record-to-Report activities, ensuring accurate financial reporting, timely month-end close, and robust balance sheet governance. Manages a team performing reconciliations, journal entries, variance analysis, and financial control activities while driving operational excellence and compliance.

•
Lead and oversee daily, monthly, and quarterly R2R activities, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and close processes.
•
Review and approve Bank, GL, and Non-GL reconciliations, ensuring timely resolution of reconciling items.
•
Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close deliverables in accordance with reporting timelines.
•
Perform aged items reviews, variance analysis, and account substantiation.
•
Ensure compliance with accounting standards, internal controls, and SOX requirements.
•
Partner with business, FP&A, AP, AR, Treasury, and external auditors to resolve accounting and reporting issues.
•
Monitor team performance against SLAs, KPIs, and quality targets.
•
Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
•
Support audits by providing reconciliations and supporting documentation.
•
Coach, develop, and mentor team members while fostering a high-performance culture.

CA/CMA/CIMA Qualified

This job has supervisory duties.

FIS® Securities Finance Suite provides a holistic set of products and services that addresses the needs of the financing market. CA Pritam Mahure and Associates (PMA) is an award‑winning Chartered Accountancy firm recognized as a leader in GST and Indirect Taxes, supporting businesses in India and abroad with complex GST matters, disputes, and compliance. With a team of more than 50 members comprising of Chartered Accountants, consultants, and trained professionals, PMA combines technical tax expertise with practical business understanding.

PMA has trained tens of thousands of professionals and government officials on GST, authored leading GST publications, and regularly contributes to professional and industry forums in India and the Middle East. Its clientele includes listed companies, major consulting firms, start‑ups, and organizations across sectors such as real estate, manufacturing, pharma, IT, banking, hospitality, retail, agriculture, and energy.

Role Description You will support the team in delivering GST advisory, compliance, and litigation services as an on‑site internship role based in Pune City. Day‑to‑day responsibilities include assisting in GST return preparation and review, compiling and analyzing data for GST health checks, and supporting documentation for audits, investigations, and assessments. The trainee will help in drafting notes, working papers, and summaries on GST issues, and in researching relevant provisions, notifications, circulars, and case laws. The role also involves contributing to client presentations, internal knowledge material, and standard operating procedures, while coordinating with team members to ensure accurate and timely work delivery. The internship provides hands‑on exposure to diverse industries and real‑world GST applications under the guidance of experienced professionals.

Qualifications
• CA Inter Both Groups Passed.
• Sound understanding of basic accounting and taxation concepts, with a keen interest in GST and Indirect Taxes.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with the ability to handle data, prepare reports, and create structured documentation.
• Keen interest to use AI
• Ability to conduct structured legal and tax research, interpret statutes and case laws, and summarize findings clearly.
• Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a systematic approach to reviewing transactions and reconciliations.
• Stipend - INR 10,000 per month for first year. INR 14,000 per month from second year.

Company Description Long Shot Assignments is a digital platform that connects CA firms, individuals, small businesses, and corporates with service professionals for short-term professional assignments across India. Since inception, the platform has built a network of over 20,000 freelancers across more than 1,000 cities in 29 states and union territories, and continues to expand into new locations. By using Long Shot's app or web platform, clients can post their assignment requirements and leverage a match-making algorithm that identifies suitable professionals based on proximity, skills, and availability.

Professionals can register as freelancers, receive daily assignment notifications through the Long Shot Assignments app, and access current and prospective opportunities in their preferred locations. This network-driven model offers flexible, project-based work and exposure to diverse clients and industries.

Role Description This is a contract, on-site role for a Chartered Accountant specialized in SAP FICO, based in Mumbai. The professional will be responsible for configuring and maintaining SAP FICO modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, and Controlling, in line with client requirements. The Chartered

Accountant will work directly at client premises as assigned through the Long Shot platform, delivering high-quality, assignment-based services within agreed timelines.

Role Overview

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented FP&A Analyst to join our UK Finance team based in Pune. This is an exciting opportunity to work across the FP&A function, supporting financial planning, reporting, performance analysis, and business improvement activities.

What We’re Looking For

• Degree educated in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Analytics, Business, or a related discipline.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a natural curiosity for understanding business performance and identifying trends.

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.

• Experience working with large financial and operational datasets, including data validation, reconciliation, and analysis.

• Strong Excel skills, including the ability to manipulate and analyse complex datasets.

• Experience with Power BI or similar reporting and visualisation tools is highly desirable.

• Familiarity with Workday, Anaplan, or other planning and reporting systems, or a willingness to learn.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present information clearly and effectively.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment.

• Collaborative team player with a proactive approach and a desire to continuously improve processes and reporting.

Dotnet Architect (Cloud) - Capital Market Domain



Dotnet Architect (Cloud) - Capital Market Domain 



At FIS, our technology and our people are moving forward. We advance the way the world pays, banks and invests. We believe in building inclusive, diverse teams. Together, we innovate to help our colleagues, clients and communities succeed. If you're ready to grow your career and make an impact in fintech, we have one question: Are you FIS?




About the Role 



As a Software Architect, you will define the technical vision and architecture for enterprise-scale applications. You will modernize legacy C++ modules into high-performance, cloud-native services using .NET technologies. You will establish engineering standards and guide the delivery of secure, scalable and reliable platforms. Your success will strengthen application performance, architectural consistency and engineering effectiveness.




Your key responsibilities 






• Define technical vision, architectural blueprints and engineering roadmaps for enterprise-scale applications.Modernize legacy C++ modules into high-performance, cloud-native services using .NET technologies.



• Design robust APIs and integration layers connecting .NET applications with Java and Node.js microservices.Establish and enforce coding standards, architectural patterns and security best practices across engineering teams.



• Conduct architecture assessments and detailed code reviews for mission-critical application components.Optimize system performance, scalability, reliability, resilience and cost efficiency.



• Mentor senior developers and engineers while promoting technical excellence and continuous improvement.Partner with engineering teams, product managers and executive stakeholders to guide technical decisions.



• Evaluate third-party tools, frameworks and cloud technologies to accelerate secure and sustainable delivery.



What you bring 




Required Qualifications 




• 15+ years of software engineering experience, including three or more years in architecture or technical leadership.



• Deep expertise in modern C++, including memory management, multithreading and low-level performance optimization.



• Strong proficiency in .NET Core, .NET 6 or later, C#, Web API and microservices architecture.



• Working knowledge of Java, Spring Boot and Angular frameworks for cross-technology integration. Demonstrated ability to design distributed, high-throughput, fault-tolerant enterprise systems.



• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes and continuous integration and delivery pipelines.Proficiency with relational and NoSQL technologies, including SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake and Redis.

• AI adoption and scaling in SDLC and DevOps
